decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly support four distinct professions for Ingrid Visser: D1S1 ('focusing on orca research') supports 'orca researcher'; D1S5 ('works as a guide on a variety of eco-tourism adventures') supports 'eco-tourism guide'; D1S6 ('She is also a public speaker') supports 'public speaker'; and D1S3 ('Visser has written an autobiography... and two children's books') supports 'author'. All four candidates are directly supported by the text without contradiction.
